headline: Man Arrested in Rs 27 Lakh Job Scam
summary: A man who paid Rs 27 lakh in a gamble for a government job has ended up in a Goa jail following a scam investigation.

headline: Goa CM Promises Strict Action in Fake Job Case
summary: Chief Minister Pramod Sawant has assured that strict legal action will be taken in connection with the fake excise department job racket.

headline: Two FIRs Filed Against Taleigao Man
summary: Goa Police have registered two separate FIRs against a resident of Taleigao in relation to an ongoing job recruitment scam.

headline: Kejriwal Unveils Six Guarantees for Goa
summary: AAP leader Arvind Kejriwal announced six promises for Goa, including free electricity and a monthly financial aid of Rs 3,000 for women.

headline: Veteran Actor Nana Patekar Passes Away at 75
summary: Renowned actor Nana Patekar has died at the age of 75 after suffering a cardiac arrest at his residence in Goa.

headline: Goa Police Register Unnatural Death Case for Nana Patekar
summary: Authorities have filed an unnatural death case and launched an inquest following the sudden passing of actor Nana Patekar in Goa.

headline: Special PMLA Court Orders Charges in Yudivo Scam
summary: A special PMLA court in Goa has ordered the framing of charges in connection with the Rs 3-crore Yudivo multi-level marketing scam.

headline: Green Tribunal Stays Port Channel-Deepening Project
summary: The National Green Tribunal has granted a stay on environmental clearance for the Mormugao Port Authority's channel-deepening project.

headline: CM Sawant Comments on Goa 2027 Leadership
summary: Goa Chief Minister Pramod Sawant stated that his party will decide on leadership for 2027, while his current focus is on winning elections.

headline: Goa Cabinet Clears Key Decisions
summary: The Goa cabinet has approved several important policy decisions affecting the tourism, agriculture, and urban development sectors.

headline: FC Goa and Chennaiyin Renew ISL Rivalry
summary: FC Goa and Chennaiyin FC are set to face each other once again, renewing their fierce rivalry in the Indian Super League.

headline: Robots to Transform Goa Coconut Harvesting
summary: Goa's traditional coconut harvesting sector is set to adopt high-tech automation with the introduction of specialized agricultural robots.
